map.💡 Pearl 指数 =（意外妊娠数 × 12 × 100）/（使用人数 × 使: 💡 Pearl Index = (unintended pregnancies x 12 x 100) / (number of women x months of use); it is the number of unintended pregnancies per 100 women using the method for one year.
map.Pearl 指数受研究人群、依从性、随访完整性影响，不同文献数据可能不同。: The Pearl Index is affected by study population, adherence and follow-up completeness; figures vary across studies.

map.Pearl 指数 0.9 表示 100 名妇女用此法 1 年约 0.9 人妊娠，: Pearl Index 0.9 means about 0.9 pregnancies per 100 women in one year; <1 is extremely effective. If 100 women are observed for only 6 months, convert to woman-years (women x months / 12).
map.Pearl 指数越低越好吗？: Is a lower Pearl Index always better?
map.是的，越低代表年意外妊娠越少、避孕越可靠。但 Pearl 指数受使用依从性影响，: Yes—lower means fewer annual unintended pregnancies and more reliable contraception. But it is influenced by adherence; perfect- vs typical-use rates differ greatly.
